notes: Equipment loan with no ratio or net-worth covenants. Section 6.c (LSB MM Fund) requires topping up a pledged money-market account to $15,000,000 if Cash on Hand drops below $75,000,000 -- a springing cash-collateral obligation rather than a standing financial covenant, so it is optional (required: false). Section 6.a only requires reporting Cash on Hand.

financial_covenants.citation_contains: maintain a cash balance of not less than fifteen million Dollars
